column1: # r3: names for the game image range 0x800B4720 - 0x800CD798 (wave 1, agent names-r3; map: docs/code/r3.md)
# Reconciled with the other areas' maps (wave 1): docs/code/NAMING.md has the conventions, which override this
# header where they differ, and every decision; each old name has one row over all the maps; labels to delete
# rather than rename are in drop.tsv.
# format: docs/port/PCONLY.md section 3. Sections: functions, data used only here, fields, files; "# shared" = data also used outside the range.
# "_stub" names: empty 2-word functions the N64 compiler left where it inlined and deleted a static (no callers); the
# original name is the inlined function's. Interior aliases: symbols that point inside another datum (named after it).
